metadata.alignment: next-token prediction queries p-1:p-1+n for attention and entropy
metadata.entropy_definition: current text-only entropy minus current real-audio entropy (nats)
metadata.training_delta_definition: historical fixed-base control: base entropy with audio IDs retained but no features minus current audio entropy; not the periodic training reference
metadata.refreshed_delta_definition: saved boundary reference (= current policy) without audio features, retaining audio IDs, minus current audio entropy
metadata.preceding_delta_definition: previous 100-step checkpoint without audio features minus current audio entropy; boundary reconstruction, not the exact pre-update training batch
metadata.silence_definition: current log p(token|real audio) minus current log p(token|same-duration silence)

gate.decision: keep rank 16; rank-32 comparison is not yet justified

training_curve.caveat: Rolling on-policy accuracy uses different training prompts across windows; it is a directional optimization diagnostic, not a held-out estimate.
